title: A Handbook of Slow Decay
summary: A handbook of touches that start a creeping rot in cloth and leather and wood and dull the strength of living flesh.

summary: A workbook on guards of packed grey ash and dust that let a blow die against the arm.

title: Primer of the Quiet Step
summary: A primer on soundless footwork and held breath that fades the user from a foe's notice and drains the room of noise.

title: The Draining Touch Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book on pulling warmth and strength out of a foe through the palm and fingertips.

title: Handbook of the Fading Breath
summary: A handbook on shortening a foe's wind and clouding the senses until the breath fails to feed the limbs.

title: The Pall and Hush Primer
summary: A primer on spreading a thin weakening pall around the body so that those near it tire and grow quiet.

title: A Workbook of the Cooling Hand
summary: A workbook on the hand that takes heat from flesh and leaves it numb and clumsy.
